children: jumped 21.4% in the morning session after the company reported strong third-quarter 2026 financial results and raised its full-year revenue growth outlook.

According to a company press release, Crocs reported that Crocs Brand revenue increased 4%, while HEYDUDE Brand revenue rose 6% during the third quarter. The company also raised its full-year enterprise revenue growth forecast to approximately 3% and boosted its adjusted earnings per share outlook. Crocs repurchased approximately 2.0 million shares for $250 million during the period. Raising full-year expectations alongside positive brand performance and disciplined capital allocation provided reassurance to investors about ongoing demand momentum.
What is the market telling us

Crocs’s shares are quite volatile and have had 17 moves greater than 5% over the last year. But moves this big are rare even for Crocs and indicate this news significantly impacted the market’s perception of the business.

Crocs is up 73.9% since the beginning of the year, and at $151.21 per share, it has set a new 52-week high. Despite the year-to-date gain, investors who bought $1,000 worth of Crocs’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $936.60.
